```{r}
#| label: fig-inhospdeathcause2
#| fig-cap: "In-hospital outcomes vs bilirubin"
#| fig-subcap:
#| - In-hospital death
#| - In hosp worsening HF
#| - Vasoactive support any of dobuta dopa milri enox lev
#| - Vasocative support any of norepi epi vasopress
#| - Nitrates iv
#| - Iv diuretics
#| - Short term mech support
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| layout-ncol: 3
#| layout-nrow: 3

barplotfunc <- function(var, varname) {
  plotdata <- escdata %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>%
    group_by(Bili_mgdL_cat) %>%
    count(!!sym(var)) %>%
    mutate(
      p = n / sum(n) * 100,
      pprint = fn(p, 0),
      Bili_mgdL_cat = fct_inorder(str_replace_all(Bili_mgdL_cat, "<=", "\u2264")),
      var = fct_rev(fct_inorder(if_else(!!sym(var) == "Yes", varname, !!sym(var))))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(y = p, x = Bili_mgdL_cat, fill = var)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = global_cols[c(1, 2)]) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "lightgrey",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = 2
      ),
      text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(y = "Proportion (%)") +
    # scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = pprint), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.25, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(p)
  }
  p
}

barplotfunc(var = "death_baseline_C_fac", varname = "In-hospital death")
barplotfunc(var = "DCWHF", varname = "Worsening of HF")
barplotfunc("vaso_dobuta_dopa_milri_enox_lev", "Dobutamine/Dopamine/Milrinone/Enoximone/Levosimendan")
barplotfunc("vaso_norepi_epi_vasopress", "Norepinephrine/Epinephrine/Vasopressin/Other")
barplotfunc("ITNITH", "Nitrates IV")
barplotfunc("ITDIURH", "Diuretics IV")
barplotfunc("ITSTMEC", "Short-term mechanical circulatory support")
```
